claim: A holonomy in SL(2,F_p)^R, with one block per resource, fingerprints concurrent histories: it is invariant under reordering of independent actions, sensitive to swaps of dependent ones, and mergeable from two fingerprints in time independent of log length.
limits: Not adversarially secure (Cayley-hash collision attacks exist). A per-resource SHA-256 baseline decides equality equally correctly and 5.9x faster per event; the advantage is composition only. One alphabet, length 200, one prime; x86_64 and the S25 (aarch64) agree on every exact count.
